A '''sun''' was the [[Star/Legends|star]] of [[Iphigin]]<ref name="Specter">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].<ref name="DateSotP">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Specter of the Past]]'' to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]</ref>

{{Star-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The sun appeared on a map in the novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[1997]] as part one of the ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''.<ref name="Specter" />

*''[[Specter of the Past]]'' {{Ab|Specter of the Past (unabridged audiobook)}} {{1st|in book}} {{C|Map only}}
